title: Factory Production Orders — Build Class Schedule: Qualifying Features and Unit Maximums
content:
Factory Production Orders are built in six build classes, and every order is built in one of them. The class is fixed by the features the order contains, and each class sets the most units one factory order may carry.

## Class schedule

| Rank | Build class | Features that place an order in the class | Most units per order |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Custom Size Build | standard white or almond frames; custom sizes within the series limits; factory-primed entry doors | 40 |
| 2 | Custom Color Build | non-white exterior color; factory-painted or stained door finish | 40 |
| 3 | Specialty Glass Build | triple-pane glass; laminated or tempered glass; decorative or blinds-between-glass door inserts | 30 |
| 4 | Specialty Shape Build | arches, circles, trapezoids or other non-rectangular shapes | 12 |
| 5 | Impact-Rated Build | impact-rated laminated glass with impact-certified frames | 20 |
| 6 | Architectural Wood Build | Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad windows; Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 30 |

Rank 6 is the highest-ranked class and rank 1 the lowest. An order takes the highest-ranked class whose listed features it contains, so an order showing features of two classes is placed in the one with the higher rank.

## Reading the schedule

- **Features.** A feature listed for a class is enough to place the order in that class when no higher-ranked class's feature is present on the order.
- **Unit maximum.** The figure in the last column is the largest unit count one factory order of that class may carry; it is set per class and applies to each order separately.

## Illustrations (hypothetical orders)

- A hypothetical vinyl order of white frames in custom sizes, with one arched unit among them, contains a Custom Size Build feature (rank 1) and a Specialty Shape Build feature (rank 4); it is a Specialty Shape Build, and it may carry at most 12 units.
- A hypothetical order of Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad windows with laminated glass contains a Specialty Glass Build feature (rank 3) and an Architectural Wood Build feature (rank 6); it is an Architectural Wood Build, with at most 30 units.
- A hypothetical order of non-white exterior color units with no glass, shape, impact or wood-clad feature is a Custom Color Build, with at most 40 units.
